step5.title: Ready to play?
step5.body: Let's play a practice hand first — zero risk.

tutorial.instructionHit: Tap Hit to draw a card.
tutorial.instructionStand: Tap Stand to keep your hand.

round1.body: Drawing a card just got you the best score possible. The dealer stops at 18: you win!

round2.title: Nice
round2.body: Your hand was already strong: standing was the right call. The dealer stops at 17: you win again!

round3.title: Not this time
round3.body: Going over 21 is an automatic loss — that's called busting. Even good play loses sometimes!
